_boundary_note: clk/rstn + one 512-bit AXIS slave (QDMA H2C in) + one 512-bit AXIS master (QDMA C2H out), tuser = {dst[15:0], src[15:0], size[15:0]}. AXI-Lite deliberately NOT crossed into the RP (R80). Defined by hw/src/pyro_rp_stub.v; every child must match it exactly or it will not link against the locked static (R82b).

PYRO_RP._pblock_note: docs/device-bringup.md quotes CLOCKREGION_X5Y7:X5Y8 for pyro_rp, but OpenNIC places its own packet-adapter pblocks on row Y8 (X1Y8:X2Y8 and X5Y8:X6Y8), which that range overlaps. This uses the SLR2 region ebpf-os proved out on this exact part instead. Patterns measure 197-410 LUTs (docs/vivado-toolchain.md §6), so region size is not the constraint -- avoiding the collision is.

opennic._pf_note: OpenNIC requires NUM_PHYS_FUNC == NUM_CMAC_PORT, so pf=cmac=1 gives exactly one pyro_rp.
